The '''Volmey Strip''' was located in the [[Rym Mountains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Accessible only by air, the strip was two hundred [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] towards the interior of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. A landmark, it was used as a meeting place for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The approach was extremely dangerous, requiring [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to fly through subterranean caverns, through an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] grotto then into a rift of plateaus at the base of the canyon.<ref name="BSS" />
